title: RNA isolation using the miRNeasy Micro Kit
protocol: Transfer 200 µl of biofluid into a 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Add 1000 µl of QIAzol Lysis Reagent to the tube.
Vortex for 5 seconds.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 200 µl chloroform to the sample.
Shake vigorously for 15 seconds.
Incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge the sample for 15 minutes at 12,000 x g at 4°C.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Carefully measure the aqueous phase and add 1.5 volumes of 100% ethanol.
Mix gently and thoroughly.
Assemble a MinElute spin column in a new collection tube.
Load up to 700 µl of the mixture from step 5 onto the column, including any precipitate that may have formed.
Spin for 15 seconds at 8,000 x g at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through.
Repeat steps 13-15 until the entire sample has been loaded.
Add 700 µl Buffer RWT to the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at 8,000 x g at room temperature to wash the column.
Discard the flow-through.
Pipette 500 μl Buffer RPE onto the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at 8000 x g to wash the column.
Discard the flow-through.
Pipette 500 µl 80% ethanol onto the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at ≥ 8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm) at room temperature to wash the column.
Discard the collection tube with the flow-through.
Transfer the RNeasy MinElute spin column into a new 2 ml collection tube.
Centrifuge at full speed for 5 minutes to dry the membrane.
Discard the collection tube with the flow-through.
Transfer the RNeasy MinElute spin column to a new 1.5 ml collection tube.
Add 14 μl RNase-free water directly to the center of the spin column membrane.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at full speed to elute the RNA.
